# Markov-state-based approach to liquidity-shock detection and response

A concept shared by **72** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #1,756. The CSV rates every member: *Low confidence — reconstructed from the algorithm title; executable rules and source support are not established.* None is implemented in volatility-ai.

## Description

Proposed Markov-state-based approach to liquidity-shock detection and response: Estimate when spreads, depth, or order-flow intensity may deteriorate and adapt trade size, timing, or order placement to reduce execution risk. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
